boundary.proved: R444 connects the source-shaped limbRun first-eight-word, no-refill result/value/state/block/index facts to the initial-block scan under its bounded fragment; R447 gives the exact first-limb failure and value masses over a uniform 32-byte-block model for arbitrary H and source state.

boundary.first_remaining: Prove the conditional actual refill law and couple the entire four-limb sampler to the shared-oracle probability model.
